messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.
Perform a droplet-scale estrogen assay including sample lysis, liquid-liquid extraction using methanol and isooctane with pooling loops, extract reconstitution, and ELISA fluorescence readout.

module fluorescence

manifest raw_sample
manifest lysing_solvent
manifest methanol
manifest isooctane
manifest elisa_reagent

instructions:

sample = dispense 1 units of raw_sample

repeat 5 times {
    lyse = dispense 2 units of lysing_solvent
    sample = mix sample with lyse for 60s
    heat sample at 23c for 1m
    dispose lyse
}

meoh = dispense 2 units of methanol
lysate = mix sample with meoh for 30s

octane = dispense 5 units of isooctane
extraction = mix lysate with octane for 20s
dispose octane

repeat 4 times {
    meoh = dispense 2 units of methanol
    lysate = mix sample with meoh for 30s
    octane = dispense 5 units of isooctane
    extraction = mix extraction with octane for 20s
    dispose octane
}

heat extraction at 25c for 10m
recon = dispense 1 units of methanol
final_extract = mix extraction with recon for 30s

elisa = dispense 1 units of elisa_reagent
readout_mix = mix final_extract with elisa for 60s
estradiol_reading = detect fluorescence on readout_mix for 5m

dispose readout_mix
